status: proposed_researched_unresolved; not root accepted; native holds remain
decision_basis: The original simplified-source contacts are reproduced exactly. Full-resolution retained RUS/UKR source records are directly contradictory for these exact centers. Primary treaty text/map research and targeted same-vintage OSM relation/member lineage research did not resolve the applicable point-side/source relationship. All actual attempts and limits are retained below. This is a bounded researched-unresolved proposal, not an assertion that every conceivable source or archival route was exhausted.
shared_source_result: All five are original mapped_land_support rows, each with an exact UKR ADM1 contact. Full-source comparison finds each center inside the matching full UKR ADM1 record and outside its matching full RUS ADM2 record, contrary to a simple positive RUS owner interpretation. The source archive contains complete records and provenance; neither source is represented as current legal authority.

research_steps.step: Reconcile original exact keys and native contacts
research_steps.result: Copied the five exact rows, interval ordinals, owner IDs/names, classes, and source foreign-contact IDs from the retained 9,451-key tuple inventory. The unchanged native holds and original interval ownership remain intact. No observer or physical/native producer was rerun.

Retained archived complete RUS and UKR source records show opposite owner/foreign inclusion for all five keys. The exact RUS archive bytes are 50,309,119 bytes, SHA-256 faa6461e6a85d021ac4b99ee983b3cf92fa05d4468a8ea79e2dea2615fc30aab, pinned to geoBoundaries commit 9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d and sourceData/gbOpen/RUS_ADM2.zip. The Sumy comparison report uses the correct hash. Three other historic reports contain a one-character checksum transcription error; retained bytes are unchanged and the verified checksum is documented in the existing addendum.

The retained RUS feature ID 1241910 matches OSM relation 1241910 by name/admin tags. Relation v25 (2017-11-20) contains outer way 131381559 v10 (2014-06-29), whose local historic nodes 359597803 and 978262909 stayed at their recorded coordinates until 2020. Target is about 4.469 m from that historical segment by local equirectangular diagnostic. OSM relation v25 full route returned HTTP404 in retained work; this is not an access denial. A full historic relation polygon was not reconstructed. Treaty sheet N-36-128-B provides regional route context but map ink/control does not establish the center side. The point remains materially ambiguous.

research_steps.result: Retained RUS feature ID 1517228 matches OSM relation 1517228 by name/admin tags. A bounded historical Overpass query returned HTTP406 twice, with the exact response retained; this is not an access denial. The treaty sheet is adverse but conditional map registration lacks independent controls. Full historic relation geometry was not reconstructed.

research_steps.step: Primary treaty/map context and reasonable remaining limitations
research_steps.result: Original treaty text and relevant map sheets were inspected, including sheet-level labels/routes and targeted local controls. Sumy, Tarasovsky and Krasnosulinsky map placement remains conditional or ambiguous due to map scale/ink, local marker absence, or registration/control limitations. No present-day sovereignty, legal boundary or current authority conclusion is inferred from names or polygons.

unperformed_or_limited_routes: No full historic OSM relation polygon was reconstructed. Official OSM element-version/history responses and local boundary-member/node histories were examined. A relation-version full request returned 404 for Sumy; the bounded dated Overpass historical query for Krasnosulinsky returned HTTP406 twice. OSM documentation limits the main editing API to element-scale use and points bulk historical consumers to Overpass/extracts. A full recursive member/node crawl was not undertaken because it would be a large historical data extraction, not a bounded local evidence check; no statement of global unavailability or access denial is made.

The retained RUS archive represented year is 2017, but capture date/version is not authenticated. Existing public archived bytes and source comparison are preserved; no second archive download or modern-source substitution was made.

The treaty maps do not provide independently controlled pointwise georeferencing adequate to resolve these center-side contradictions. The related map inspections and controls are cited in the retained reports; no missing marker is converted into proof of either side.
remaining_obstacle: Current sources are incompatible at the five centers, and the retained historical local boundary evidence is close but cannot establish source applicability/side. No justified positive repair is supported. Reasonable targeted source, map and relation-lineage work has been done; the remaining unperformed full historical polygon reconstruction is a broad recursive extraction rather than a bounded contract-required step. The proposal remains reviewable and does not call the overall search exhaustive.
